invariants.value: the chart and ONE test frame are approved by the owner before the full build (lune run kit vfx chart <set>)
invariants.why: two FlameArc redos came from building before the owner saw a frame

invariants.value: about 44% of layers non-additive, a dark twin behind every bright shape, layer lives near 0.58 s, front-loaded curves

invariants.value: VfxBudget <= 0.5 ms a frame; flashes at most 3 a second (WCAG)
no blood or gore of any kind; embers cool through orange to grey ash, never deep red dots
invariants.why: Roblox moderates the account that uploads blood or gore

slots.question: Which source scene should the effect's frames come from?
options: *A Name the anime scene or clip and its episode (the breakdown reads its real frames)
B An original effect: one test frame first for the owner to approve

slots.question: What colour plan should the effect follow?
options: *A The source scene's own colours, measured from its frames
B A named palette (say the two or three colours)

slots.question: How much should be built this round?
options: *A One beat or one effect, chart and test frame first
B The whole multi-shot sequence (V5) after the chart is approved

steps: lune run kit start vfx (the boot sheet, golden and graveyard pages)
kit vfx breakdown <set> --clip <file> --fps 2, then --dense round every beat: lead-in, hit frame, frames held, fade
kit vfx chart <set> and one test frame; ask the owner and record kit approve vfx <name> --stage style
build beat by beat in the player (kit vfx <name>); kit vfx dailies <name> shows the scene above ours at the same times
show the owner, then kit verdict vfx <name> <0-10> "<their words>"
done_when: kit verdict vfx <name> recorded from the owner's words
engine_caps: a Beam is at most 50 studs wide; a giant column is a mesh
a Beam texture runs its vertical axis along the beam
a ParticleEmitter with TimeScale 0 still emits: disable rate emitters during holds
sound / screen / shake radius at most 1000

failure_lexicon.floaty: the key beat arrives within 1 frame of the hit and holds at least 0.73 s, measured by kit vfx dailies
failure_lexicon.slow: the key beat arrives within 1 frame of the hit; lead-in measured from the scene, never guessed
failure_lexicon.washed: about 44% non-additive layers and a dark twin behind every bright shape
failure_lexicon.plastic: air and energy are never solid surfaces: textured flaring shells and feathered discs facing the flow
failure_lexicon.generic: the look comes from this subject's own source frames, never the last showpiece's
failure_lexicon.cool: the hit frame, the hold and the fade are measured from the source scene
